Brochure warranty period
5 years (conditions apply)

The brochure lists a 5-year conditional warranty and 3 years for natural color fading. It requires authorized installation and an electronic warranty. Overseas applicability has not been confirmed.

Material & application

  • TPU color paint protection film
  • Scratch-recovery coating described in the brochure
  • Listed as part of the AT Color PPF collection

For automotive body panels. Confirm the selected film and finish with a qualified installer.

Installation & care

  • The brochure describes lightly wet installation for gloss TPU.
  • Matte TPU is described as dry-applied with an air-channel liner; large areas may be wet-applied.
  • Have a qualified installer confirm the method for the selected material.
